description: Tier 7 PR 6: Paged event history API over trading_events.jsonl and session_snapshot.py extension with control plane summary fields. Depends on PR 1 (trading_events.py) being merged. Low risk — read-only new file + minor schema extension.

userStories.title: Create event_history.py with paged JSONL reader
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a paged history API to answer 'what happened around this trade?' without loading the entire event log into memory.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at src/scanner/automation/event_history.py
HistoryPage dataclass has fields: events (list), first_id (str or None), has_more (bool)
EventHistory class has __init__(jsonl_path='trained_data/trading_events.jsonl')
get_latest(n=20) returns the N most recent events as a HistoryPage — reads from tail of JSONL, does NOT load entire file
get_before(cursor_id, n=20) returns N events older than cursor_id as a HistoryPage with has_more flag
filter_by(event_type=None, pair=None, trade_id=None, session_id=None) returns matching events (scans file, applies all non-None filters with AND logic)
All methods return TradingEvent objects (imported from trading_events.py) parsed from JSONL lines
Gracefully handles: missing file (returns empty HistoryPage), corrupted JSON lines (skips them with structlog warning), empty file
python -c 'from src.scanner.automation.event_history import EventHistory, HistoryPage' succeeds
Syntax validation passes: python -m py_compile src/scanner/automation/event_history.py
userStories.notes: For get_latest(), read the file in reverse (seek to end, read backwards in chunks) to avoid loading the whole file. A simpler approach for v1: readlines()[-n:] is acceptable if file size stays under ~50MB. For get_before(), scan backwards from the cursor_id position. Each JSONL line should be a dict with at least an 'event_id' key for cursor-based pagination. Import TradingEvent and TradingEventType from src.scanner.automation.trading_events. Use structlog for logging.

userStories.title: Unit tests for event_history.py
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the history API covering pagination, filters, and edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at tests/test_event_history.py

At least 8 tests covering: get_latest returns N most recent events, get_latest on empty file returns empty HistoryPage, get_before with valid cursor returns older events, get_before sets has_more=True when more events exist, get_before sets has_more=False at beginning of file, filter_by event_type returns only matching events, filter_by pair returns only matching pair, filter_by with multiple filters uses AND logic, corrupted JSONL line is skipped gracefully (no crash)
Tests use tmp_path fixture to create temporary JSONL files with known content
Tests pass: python -m pytest tests/test_event_history.py -v
userStories.notes: Create test helper that writes N TradingEvent dicts as JSONL lines to a tmp file. Use create_trade_closed_event() from trading_events.py to generate realistic events. For the cursor test: write 30 events, get_latest(10) returns last 10, get_before(first_id_from_page, 10) returns events 11-20, has_more=True. For corruption test: insert a line like '{invalid json' between valid lines.

userStories.title: Extend session_snapshot.py with control plane summary fields
userStories.description: As an operator, I need session snapshots to include control plane health so that post-session review shows queue depth, reconnects, and policy blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: src/scanner/automation/session_snapshot.py is modified (not replaced)

Snapshot schema extended with optional fields: control_plane_summary (dict with keys: transport_state, degraded_mode, degraded_duration_seconds, reconnect_count), queue_summary (dict with keys: depth, failed_count, handlers_completed), policy_summary (dict with keys: blocks_count, last_block_action, last_block_reason)
All new fields default to None or empty dict so existing code is not broken
Existing snapshot creation and persistence behavior is unchanged
Existing tests still pass: python -m pytest tests/ -k snapshot -v --timeout=30 (if any exist, otherwise verify no import errors)
Syntax validation passes: python -m py_compile src/scanner/automation/session_snapshot.py
userStories.notes: Read the existing session_snapshot.py first to understand the current schema. Add the new fields as optional dict parameters to the snapshot creation function/class. Use field(default_factory=dict) or default=None for dataclass fields. Do NOT change existing field names or types. The control plane and queue modules don't exist yet — these fields will be populated later in PR 5. For now they just need to exist in the schema with safe defaults.
